source: synthetic CPPP CPWD building works tender (evals/golden/in/cppp_cpwd_building)

requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 9,00,00,000 in the last three financial years.
The bidder shall furnish an EMD of Rs. 18,00,000 by online payment or a bank guarantee from a scheduled commercial bank.
The bidder shall have at least 5 years of experience in building renovation works of comparable value.
The bidder shall be enrolled on the CPP Portal and shall hold a valid Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate.
The bidder shall submit a solvency certificate of Rs. 3,60,00,000 issued within the last twelve months.
8.1 The contractor shall renovate 18,400 square metres of office space including civil, electrical and HVAC works.
8.2 The contractor shall complete the work within 15 months from the date of the work order.
8.3 The contractor must obtain all statutory clearances including the fire safety certificate before handover.
8.4 The contractor shall carry out the work in occupied premises in phases agreed with the engineer in charge.
8.5 The contractor should propose measures to limit dust and noise during working hours.
Documents shall be uploaded as PDF files; each file shall not exceed 30 MB.
Bids shall be uploaded on the CPP Portal before 15:30 hours IST on 05-01-2027.
The technical and financial covers shall be digitally signed with a Class 3 DSC.
The bidder shall upload an affidavit confirming that the firm is not blacklisted by any government department.
The lowest evaluated financial bid among technically qualified bidders will be recommended for award.
Technical evaluation will verify similar completed works, the solvency certificate and the bid capacity.
